name: Demo person
shortBio: Minimal profile fixture used by the route-replacement demo.
summary: This profile only exists to satisfy the editorial theme's home and about screens — the interesting part of this demo is what happens to /work and /writing.
longBio: This demo focuses on a single thing: proving that the four replaceable editorial-theme screens (/work, /work/[slug], /writing, /writing/[slug]) can all be disabled together and replaced with consumer-local pages from src/pages-local.
Everything else on the site — home, about — uses the editorial theme defaults so the replacement story is the only variable.
